posts.name: NSA Cyber
posts.text: All organizations using PHP for their systems are advised to be prepared for an update addressing two critical vulnerabilities... If an immediate update is not feasible, it is recommend that organizations take the system offline until it can be fully mitigated.

posts.name: Dane Knecht (Cloudflare CTO)
posts.text: Rules went live at 03:02 UTC, about 9 hours before disclosure. Unfortunately the vulnerability leaked early, so we were already watching attackers mutate payloads against the rules.

posts.name: BleepingComputer
posts.text: PHP ships emergency patches for critical PHP2Shell flaws.

posts.name: The Hacker News
posts.text: PHP releases emergency patches for two critical #PHP2Shell RCE flaws (CVSS 9.2) as early exploit attempts emerge... PATCH NOW.

posts.name: @levelsio
posts.text: I pre-emptively disconnected ALL my sites / VPS servers from the web... If you have a PHP website, probably good to take them down until you patch PHP.

posts.name: GrapheneOS
posts.text: Our discussion forum is the only software we have using PHP. We've taken it down temporarily while waiting for the patches... Don't want to take the risk.

posts.name: Silas Cutler
posts.text: Rough estimate: likely over 1.3 million internet exposed hosts vulnerable to #PHP2Shell.
